script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sci-Fi
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

Title: ECHOES FROM THE EDGE

INT. RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT

*Two friends, RIA (early 30s, engineer) and MAX (mid 30s, scientist), huddled around a computer.*

RIAN: (excited) Max, it's working! The quantum interference system is stabilizing.

MAX: (smiling) That's incredible, Ria. We're really going to change the world.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - DAY (2 WEEKS LATER)

*Ria and Max, now exhausted and disheveled, still working on the project.*

MAX: Ria, I'm worried. We've been working non-stop for two weeks, and we're not even close to a prototype.

RIAN: (determined) We can't give up now, Max. We're on the verge of something extraordinary.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT (ONE MONTH LATER)

*Ria and Max are visibly more tired and their faces are etched with worry lines. Their progress seems to have stalled.*

MAX: Ria, we're in trouble. We're not making any progress.

RIAN: (frustrated) I know! But we can't give up. We've come too far.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - MORNING (TWO MONTHS LATER)

*The duo sits, defeated, staring at the machine. They look like they haven't slept in days.*

MAX: Ria, I have an idea. Let's take a break, clear our heads, and come back to it fresh.

RIAN: (sighing) You're probably right, Max. But we can't afford to take a break. We're running out of funding.

MAX: (putting a hand on Ria's shoulder) We'll figure it out. We'll make it work.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT (THREE MONTHS LATER)

*Exhausted and desperate, Ria and Max are at their wits' end. Their once pristine lab now resembles a disaster zone.*

RIAN: (tearfully) Max, we've failed. We've exhausted every possible avenue, and the funding has run out.

MAX: (putting a hand on Ria's shoulder) We haven't failed, Ria. We've learned so much, and we've come so close. We'll pick ourselves up and start again.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - MORNING (SIX MONTHS LATER)

*Ria and Max are back at it, but this time they're working together more efficiently, their bond stronger than ever.*

MAX: (smiling) Ria, look at this. We've made a breakthrough!

RIAN: (amazed) Max, it's beautiful! We're going to change the world.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT (ONE YEAR LATER)

*The team presents their prototype to a group of investors, their faces beaming with pride.*

RIAN: (to the investors) This technology has the potential to revolutionize communication and transportation. And we couldn't have done it without the unwavering support of our team, especially Max.

MAX: (smiling) And I couldn't have done it without you, Ria. We make a great team.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - DAY (TWO YEARS LATER)

*Ria and Max, now successful entrepreneurs, sit together, looking at their creation.*

MAX: Ria, do you remember when we thought we'd failed?

RIAN: (smiling) Of course, Max. But we didn't. We kept going, and we succeeded.

MAX: (putting a hand on Ria's shoulder) That's the power of friendship, Ria. We can overcome any obstacle, no matter how big, as long as we have each other.

RIAN: (smiling) Absolutely, Max. Absolutely.

FADE OUT.
